overview.en: Qwen3-ASR-1.7B is a 1.7B-parameter automatic speech recognition model from the Qwen team. It supports Chinese and English speech, Chinese dialects, multilingual speech, and singing voice transcription, with long-audio and streaming inference. This recipe migrates the official vLLM Ascend tutorial into structured YAML, with end-to-end verification on Atlas 300I DUO (310P) using vLLM / vLLM Ascend 0.23.0. Requires audio extras (`pip install av soundfile` or `vllm[audio]`).
overview.zh: Qwen3-ASR-1.7B 是 Qwen 团队的 1.7B 参数自动语音识别模型，支持中英文、中文方言、多语言语音和歌唱转写，以及长音频与流式推理。本 recipe 将官方 vLLM Ascend tutorial 迁移为结构化 YAML，并在 Atlas 300I DUO（310P）上用 vLLM / vLLM Ascend 0.23.0 完成端到端验证。需要音频依赖（`pip install av soundfile` 或 `vllm[audio]`）。

prerequisites[0].content.en:
| Weight Version | Hardware Requirements | Download Links |
|----------------|------------------------|----------------|
| BF16 | one Ascend Atlas 800I A2 64 GB NPU or one Ascend Atlas 300I DUO 48 GB NPU | [ModelScope](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B) |

Download weights to a directory accessible from the deployment environment (for example `/root/.cache/`).

Register the recipe `model.model_id` in `models/_cache_paths.yaml` so CI can resolve `your_model_path` from the runner cache.

> **Path description**: Record the local path and ensure subsequent `vllm serve` commands use the same directory (or the ModelScope / HuggingFace model id with cache enabled).

| Weight Version | Hardware Requirements | Download Links |
|----------------|------------------------|----------------|
| BF16 | one Ascend Atlas 800I A2 64 GB NPU or one Ascend Atlas 300I DUO 48 GB NPU | [ModelScope](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B) |

将权重下载到部署环境可访问的目录（例如 `/root/.cache/`）。

在 `models/_cache_paths.yaml` 登记本 recipe 的 `model.model_id`，以便 CI 从 runner cache 解析 `your_model_path`。

> **路径说明**：记下本地路径，后续 `vllm serve` 使用同一目录（或启用缓存的 ModelScope / HuggingFace 模型 ID）。

prerequisites[1].content.en:
Audio decoding requires PyAV / soundfile. Inside the container or venv:

```bash
pip install av soundfile
# or: pip install "vllm[audio]"
```

Without these packages, `/v1/chat/completions` returns `Invalid or unsupported audio file`.

env_setup.container.300I DUO.content.en:
Use the official `-310p` image (verified with v0.23.0):

```bash
export IMAGE=quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:v0.23.0-310p

docker run --rm \
    --name vllm-ascend \
    --shm-size=10g \
    --net=host \
    --privileged=true \
    --device /dev/davinci0 \
    --device /dev/davinci_manager \
    --device /dev/devmm_svm \
    --device /dev/hisi_hdc \
    -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
    -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
    -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64 \
    -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
    -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
    -v /root/.cache:/root/.cache \
    -it $IMAGE bash
```

> On Atlas 300I DUO, uninstall `triton-ascend` and `triton` if installed: `pip uninstall -y triton-ascend triton`.
> Then install audio extras: `pip install av soundfile`.

scenarios[0].steps[0].content.en:
Atlas 300I DUO single-node ASR deployment (TP=1). Verified with vLLM Ascend 0.23.0 on one 310P3 (~44 GB HBM).

```bash
export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True

vllm serve your_model_path \
    --served-model-name qwen3-asr \
    --tensor-parallel-size 1 \
    --gpu-memory-utilization {{gpu_memory_utilization}} \
    --dtype float16 \
    --max-model-len {{max_model_len}} \
    --additional-config '{"ascend_compilation_config": {"fuse_norm_quant": false,"enable_npu_graph_ex":false}}' \
    --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode": "FULL_DECODE_ONLY", "cudagraph_capture_sizes": [1,4]}' \
    --host 0.0.0.0 \
    --port 8000
```

> - Replace `your_model_path` with the local weight directory or `Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B`.
> - On Atlas 300I DUO, always set `--max-model-len` explicitly (for example `4096`).
> - Expect `Application startup complete` in the log. A `No module named 'triton'` warning is expected on 310P.

evaluation.accuracy.content.en: Evaluate transcription quality with Word Error Rate (WER) and Character Error Rate (CER) on a labeled audio set. The official tutorial does not publish fixed WER/CER numbers for this model.
evaluation.accuracy.content.zh: 在标注音频集上用词错误率（WER）和字错误率（CER）评估。官方 tutorial 未给出固定 WER/CER 数字。

evaluation.performance.content.en:
Measure end-to-end ASR serving (audio preprocess + request + inference + parse). Record audio duration, concurrency, latency, real-time factor, and throughput.

| Scenario | Settings | Notes |
| -------- | -------- | ----- |
| Low latency | TP=1, `--max-model-len 4096` | Prefer short audio; avoid sharing the NPU |
| Long audio | Raise `--max-model-len` only as needed | Keep conservative on Atlas 300I DUO |
evaluation.performance.content.zh:
测量端到端 ASR 服务（音频预处理 + 请求 + 推理 + 解析）。记录音频时长、并发、时延、实时率和吞吐。

| Scenario | Settings | Notes |
| -------- | -------- | ----- |
| 低时延 | TP=1，`--max-model-len 4096` | 优先短音频；避免与其他任务共享 NPU |
| 长音频 | 仅在需要时提高 `--max-model-len` | Atlas 300I DUO 上保持保守取值 |

performance.accuracy.en: Functional verification on Atlas 300I DUO succeeded with the tutorial sample audio (HTTP 200, coherent English transcription). Publish WER/CER against your labeled set for production readiness.
performance.accuracy.zh: Atlas 300I DUO 上官方样例音频功能验证通过（HTTP 200，英文转写连贯）。生产就绪请在自有标注集上给出 WER/CER。

performance.benchmark.en: No fixed throughput numbers are claimed here. On the verified 310P host, a single tutorial-sample request completed successfully after engine warmup; re-measure with `vllm bench serve` or concurrent curl batches for your workload.
performance.benchmark.zh: 此处不宣称固定吞吐数字。已验证的 310P 上，引擎预热后单条 tutorial 样例请求成功；请用 `vllm bench serve` 或并发 curl 按实际负载复测。

faq.en:
For common environment and installation issues, see the [Public FAQs](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/en/latest/faqs.html).

### Atlas 300I DUO: Invalid or unsupported audio file

**Cause:** Missing PyAV / soundfile.

**Solution:** `pip install av soundfile` (or `pip install "vllm[audio]"`), then retry the request.

### Atlas 300I DUO: OOM during startup

**Cause:** Oversized attention mask from automatic context length.

**Solution:** Always set `--max-model-len` explicitly (for example `4096`).
faq.zh:
环境与安装类问题见[公开 FAQ](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/zh-cn/latest/faqs.html)。

### Atlas 300I DUO：Invalid or unsupported audio file

**原因：** 缺少 PyAV / soundfile。

**处理：** 执行 `pip install av soundfile`（或 `pip install "vllm[audio]"`）后重试。

### Atlas 300I DUO：启动时 OOM

**原因：** 自动上下文长度导致 attention mask 过大。

**处理：** 始终显式设置 `--max-model-len`（例如 `4096`）。
